cheats.comments: // names a code; // disabled turns off the next one.
cheats.format: One "address value" per line, in hexadecimal. The digits of the value decide the width written (2 digits: 8 bit, 4: 16 bit, 8: 32 bit).
cheats.title: Cheat codes
general.speed_hint: Tab, pressing the left stick and the status bar change it too.
general.update_folders_hint: Searched through their subfolders for the title's ID (a copy of mlc01, or one folder for many titles, works too). Takes effect from the next boot.
general.dlc_folders_hint: Searched through their subfolders for the title's ID (a copy of mlc01, or one folder for many titles, works too). Takes effect from the next boot.
graphics.gpu_hint: The GPU that draws the game. The system may compose the desktop on another one, whatever you choose here.
graphics.force60_hint: A title made for 30 fps whose logic counts frames, such as Twilight Princess HD, then runs at up to double speed.
graphics.background_shaders: Compile shaders in the background (less stutter)
graphics.background_shaders_hint:
New shaders no longer stop the game.
What uses one may be missing for a moment until it is ready.
graphics.frame_generation_hint:
Makes pictures between frames without changing the game speed.
Does not work while xBRZ is on.
graphics.max30_hint:
For titles whose logic counts frames and that run too fast.
Titles slower than 30 fps stay as they are.
graphics.memory_ran_out: Not enough video memory: 3D resolution lowered from {factor}x to {lower}x
graphics.resolution_hint:
Draws the game at a whole multiple of its resolution, up to 10240 wide.
Higher factors need much more video memory and GPU power.
It can be changed while playing; the first frame after a change looks wrong.
graphics.xbrz_unavailable: Not used while the 3D resolution is raised.
input.edit_hint: To change the bindings, edit shocora.toml (from the next start).
input.speed_keys: Tab or pressing the left stick: change the game speed
launcher.background_color_hint: See-through colors show the desktop after a restart; an opaque window costs the GPU less.
library.none: No titles found in the rom_dirs of shocora.toml.
log.fonts: system fonts: {path} (applies on the next boot)
log.add_on_folders: Update / DLC folders changed (from the next boot)
menu.gamepad_window: GamePad screen in its own window
menu.fullscreen_hint: Full screen: F11, Alt+Enter or double-click the TV screen; Esc returns
netplay.give_player1: Give player 2 the rights of player 1
netplay.give_player1_hint: Player 2 plays as player 1. Meanwhile, your input does not reach the game.
netplay.own_address_hint:
With 127.0.0.1, only this PC can join.
To play with other PCs, enter this PC's LAN or VPN address. Guests on that network can join.
The network is as large as the adapter says; override it like 10.1.2.3/16.
netplay.start_host_hint:
The password itself is never sent, but nothing is encrypted.
Use this on networks you trust.
netplay.take_player1: Take back the rights of player 1
netplay.to_gamepad_hint:
When off, you play as a Pro Controller.
Touches always reach the GamePad's screen.
status.api_hint: Click to change the graphics API (from the next start)
status.framegen_hint: Click to switch frame generation (30 → 60 fps)
status.rate_hint:
Click to cycle: as the title asks → max 30 fps → forced 60 fps.
A title made for 30 fps runs at up to double speed at 60.
status.speed_hint: Click, Tab or press the left stick to cycle 1x → 2x → 3x → 4x → 0.5x
status.xbrz_hint: Click to change the screen upscaling
